observations: The installed Gen V1 workspace is visible with the completed Installed memory review conversation in the sidebar and a collapsed Project overview disclosure.
The main conversation is empty and displays Connect a model to get started. The composer and Select model control are visible; no model response is displayed.
The Settings modal is open on Models & Accounts with the normal sidebar and close control visible.
Available models reports 0 models. The Environment variables section reports no variables configured and its secret-value input is empty.
The scrolled Models & Accounts view displays the Claude connection action, Gemini section and Cursor section with ordinary connection controls.
Gemini and Cursor show Ready to connect. Visible status text says connection status is not checked and identity is unavailable; the image does not demonstrate an authenticated account.
The pinned source panel is open inside Project memory, with the source message identifier, revision, captured sequence and digest displayed.
The synthetic UTC retention sentence and script-shaped sentinel appear as literal source text in the panel. This visual observation does not independently establish the no-execution assertion.
The Close source control and adjacent review actions remain visible.
The project-memory panel states Not enabled for this project and that this host disables memory while existing records remain reviewable.
The Accepted tab is selected. The edited UTC/ISO 8601 constraint is visible as Accepted revision 3 with its source link and Edit, Expire and Forget actions.
The selected Installed memory review source conversation remains visible and the Enable for this project control is disabled.
The rejected synthetic proposal remains visible in the review list as Expired revision 2 with an expiry timestamp.
Its source link and Edit and Forget actions are visible. A separate sensitive accepted constraint remains below it; the rejected record is not labeled accepted.
The panel displays the Forgotten notice and has Deleted history selected while the host remains disabled.
The tombstone identifies item e8b2335b-e2b4-4bd8-9e5c-4435e97d3d95 with deletion revision 3 and an exclusion timestamp.
Physical purge pending and Invalidated summaries and indexes (0) are visible. The screenshot does not claim physical deletion has completed.
The second-launch review image again shows the disabled-host notice and selected source conversation.
The Accepted tab displays the same edited UTC/ISO 8601 constraint as Accepted revision 3, with the source link and review controls still available.
Its placement in the second launch is bound by the verification receipt; the image alone is a view of the retained record.
The second-launch Deleted history view shows the same item identifier and deletion revision 3 with the same exclusion timestamp.
Physical purge pending remains visible, together with Invalidated summaries and indexes (0). The disabled-host notice and source selection remain present.
The renderer image establishes the displayed tombstone state; the receipt separately binds restart, storage and process ownership.

limits: This is an independent visual review, not the strict installed-admission result.
The screenshots do not show a native operating-system Save dialog. The native Save receipt, exact saved file and process/target ownership establish that separate proof.

Renderer images alone do not prove persistence, cleanup, source no-execution, exclusion from backend retrieval, or native ownership; the independently reviewed receipt and strict validator provide those checks.
Physical purge is explicitly pending in both tombstone images. Retrieval exclusion and a retained tombstone must not be relabeled completed physical purge.

These images cover seeded retained-memory review in the default-off installed host. Enabled installed extraction/recall/checkpoint behavior and live provider study remain unproven; both production feature flags stay false.
